result.summary: Completed a bounded public-web recovery scan of primary military-analysis institutions, specialist outlets, newsletters, and indexed analyst publications for the missing 05:00–24:00 UTC interval. No source item was admitted because exact-date searches did not resolve a stable primary publication with both canonical URL and verifiable in-window time. The raw manifest records ISW, CTP, RUSI, War on the Rocks, CEPA/FPRI, and Phillips O'Brien surfaces; exact-date queries; older out-of-window analysis; secondary-media overlap; access and indexing failures; and explicit safety boundaries. No relay timestamp or inferred identity was substituted, no artifact was captured, and no analytical judgment or report narrative was created.
coverage_gaps: The zero-item result is not evidence that no military analyst published during the interval.
Search-engine indexing may lag analyst institutions, newsletters, and public social platforms.
